css: .text-center { text-align: center; } .center-x { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; } .quote-card { background-color: #fffdf9; border-radius: 28px; padding: 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; grid-row-gap: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.08); } .stars { color: #d4502a; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .quote-text { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1.25; color: #141613; margin: 0; } .quote-author { display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 14px; } .avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 999px; flex: none; background-color: #e8e1d5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 20px; color: #141613; } .author-name { font-weight: 700; color: #141613; font-size: 15px; } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .quote-card { padding: 28px; } }
